name: Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS)
directions: How likely are you to doze or fall asleep in each situation, in contrast to feeling just tired? Think about your usual way of life in recent times. If you have not done an activity recently, estimate how it would affect you.

questions.text: Sitting, inactive, in a public place (e.g., in a meeting, theater, or dinner event)
As a passenger in a car for an hour or more without stopping for a break
Lying down to rest when circumstances permit
Sitting quietly after a meal without alcohol
In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic or at a light

interpretationNote: The supplied text identifies a score of 10 or greater as raising concern about sleepiness. This is not diagnostic.
